title: Core Glossary: Calibration Laboratories — Signature Edition — Signature Method
description: Core Glossary: Calibration Laboratories — Signature Edition — Signature Method: the working vocabulary of Calibration Laboratories — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. The Signature edition: the JAH system's original reference on Calibration Laboratories. Calibration labs certify: standards trace to NIST, uncertainties quantified, certificates issued. Trust but verify.
definition: Core Glossary: Calibration Laboratories — Signature Edition — Signature Method — the working vocabulary of Calibration Laboratories — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a d.
key_points: SOP: Standard operating procedure: the written way the lab does a task.
GLP: Good laboratory practice: the quality system for non-clinical studies.
Biosafety level: The BSL-1 to BSL-4 scale of biological containment.
Fume hood: Ventilated enclosure capturing chemical vapors at the source.
Calibration: Checking an instrument against a known standard.
Traceability: The unbroken chain from a result to a national standard.
Chain of custody: The documented handoffs proving a sample's integrity.
ALARA: As low as reasonably achievable: the radiation dose principle.
PPE: Personal protective equipment for lab hazards.
Waste stream: A categorized disposal path: chemical, biological, sharps, general.
